Asymptotic Variance of the Failure-Time Probability

Source: R/04_ftp.R
vcov_ftp.Rd

Compute the pointwise asymptotic variance of the plug-in failure-time probability estimator for an irreducible finite-state Markov chain, treating the initial distribution as fixed.

Usage

vcov_ftp(x, time, up)

Arguments

x

An object of class MarkovChain.

time

A single positive integer less than .Machine$integer.max. Missing and infinite values are not allowed.

up

Integer-valued numeric vector of state positions or character vector of state names giving the operational states. Missing values are not allowed. Duplicates are ignored; empty and full state sets are valid. States are used in their order in x.

Value

A numeric scalar containing the variance in the \(\sqrt{n}\) limit of the failure-time probability estimator. Divide by the number of observed transitions \(n\) to approximate the variance of the estimator itself. This is a pointwise variance, not a joint covariance across times.

Details

Equation (53) in Proposition 10 of Gavrilopoulos, Trevezas, and Votsi (2026) gives the limiting variable by applying the differential $$L_t(H) = a_U\left\{ \sum_{i=0}^{t-2} Q^i H_{UU} Q^{t-2-i} b + Q^{t-1} H_{UD}\mathbf{1}_{|D|}\right\},$$ where \(Q=P_{UU}\), \(b=P_{UD}\mathbf{1}_{|D|}\), and the sum is empty at \(t=1\). Both terms use the same transition estimation error; their cross-covariance is included.

If \(G\) contains the entry-wise coefficients of \(L_t\), the variance is \(g\Sigma_{\mathbf p}g^{\mathsf T}\), with \(g=\operatorname{vec}(G^{\mathsf T})^{\mathsf T}\). The implementation contracts the full-chain multinomial row covariances using the equivalent expression $$\sum_{u\in U}\frac{1}{\pi_u} \sum_{j<l}p_{uj}p_{ul}(G_{uj}-G_{ul})^2.$$ This includes cross-covariances between the operational and exit blocks, avoids constructing a dense transition covariance, and avoids subtracting nearly equal quadratic terms. The stationary probabilities \(\pi_u\) refer to the full chain. No new matrix dependencies are required.

References

Gavrilopoulos, G., Trevezas, S., and Votsi, I. (2026). Matrix asymptotic calculus for plug-in maximum likelihood estimators in finite Markov chains. arXiv preprint arXiv:2607.17161. https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.17161.

See also

ftp(), vcov_rel(), vcov_p()

Examples

P <- matrix(c(0.8, 0.2, 0.3, 0.7), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
x <- MarkovChain(c(0.4, 0.6), P)
ftp(x, time = 1:3, up = 1L)
#> [1] 0.0800 0.0640 0.0512
vcov_ftp(x, time = 3L, up = 1L)
#> [1] 0.004369067
